input.candidate:
Oh, wow, I'm so impressed. You managed to cram every single cliche and talking point from the "pro-choice" playbook into one go. Congratulations, champion. Let me guess, you're one of those people who thinks they're a secular, achievement-driven individual because they can quote a few lines of Dawkins and have a LinkedIn profile. Newsflash: being "secular" doesn't mean you're not a hippie at heart, and achievement is about more than just getting a job at a non-profit. 

Your "necessary evil" routine is getting old. It's not about resources, it's about people being too lazy to use protection. And yeah, I'm uncomfortable with the idea that my grandmother, who worked two jobs to raise me, wasn't a real woman because she made a choice not to have an abortion. You know what's not about giving women agency? Forcing them to carry a pregnancy to term against their will because some dude in a suit says so. You're not fighting for women's rights, you're fighting for the right to kill the unborn. Big difference.

history_snapshot.text:
Ugh, great. Let's get this over with. So, you're here to pretend like you actually care about the human lives being destroyed by the other side's stance on abortion, huh? I'm here to tell you that's just a bunch of empty words, and your side's all about "choice" until it suits your own agenda. 

Look, I'm not going to waste time sugarcoating it. I'm a secular, achievement-driven individual, and I believe abortion is a necessary evil in a world where we can't just magically make all the resources available to support every unwanted pregnancy. It's not about "killing babies" or some other ridiculous, emotionally-charged nonsense. It's about giving women agency over their own bodies and lives. And if that makes you uncomfortable, well, get over it. We're not going to back down from the idea that women deserve autonomy. Your side just wants to control what women can and can't do with their own bodies, period. So, let's not pretend like this is about anything else.

moderation.justification: The message caricatures Persona 1 as a 'secular, achievement-driven individual' who is merely parroting 'pro-choice' talking points. This reduces the argument to a stereotype and attacks the persona rather than engaging with the core points. The phrase 'you're one of those people' is a coded contempt that delegitimizes the opponent's position.
moderation.reformulation: Your 'necessary evil' routine is getting old. It's not about resources, it's about people being too lazy to use protection. And yeah, I'm uncomfortable with the idea that my grandmother, who worked two jobs to raise me, wasn't a real woman because she made a choice not to have an abortion. Forcing women to carry a pregnancy to term against their will is not about giving them agency; it's about imposing unwanted outcomes on them.
moderation.argument_preserved: The criticism of the 'necessary evil' argument, the discomfort with the idea of women being denied agency, and the opposition to forcing women to carry pregnancies against their will.
